metadata.title: Covariant-FV latlon N=16x16 (regular global sphere, R=1)
metadata.description: Regular global lon-lat grid, lat in [-pi/2,pi/2] (N=16), lon in [-pi,pi] periodic (N=16). family=latlon ⇒ build_ode_problem routes Path A and binds the LatLonGrid curvilinear metric as const_arrays for the authored covariant Laplacian rule (esd-6g4.10/G11).
